blocks.title: Maloomat ke liye (For Your Information)
blocks.text: Node circuit ka woh point hai jo do ya zyada branches (shaakhein) ko jorta hai.
Maan lein chaar taar ek point A par milte hain (Fig. 9.27). A ki taraf aane wale currents I₁ aur I₂ hain aur door jane wale I₃ aur I₄.

blocks.alt: Chaar taarein, har ek mein resistor, nuqte A par milti hain. Teer: I1 (baen se) aur I2 (neeche baen se) A ki taraf; I3 (neeche daen) aur I4 (oopar daen) A se door.

blocks.title: Kya aap jaante hain? (Do You Know?)
blocks.text: Jis node ka potential zero maana jaye use datum node kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kirchhoff ka pehla rule
blocks.text: Kisi point ki taraf aane wale saare currents ka sum us point se door jane wale saare currents ke sum ke barabar hota hai.

Kirchhoff ka pehla rule (jise point rule bhi kehte hain) law of conservation of charge (charge na banta hai na mit-ta hai) ki shakal hai. Agar kisi point par charge jama ya paida na ho raha ho to jitna charge point ki taraf aata hai utna hi us se door jata hai.
